SILT#00037: My steps to debug an error in order not to keep doing the same thing over and over again. 1) document what I'm going to do, 2) do the thing, 3) make note of the issue, 4) figure out what is causing the issue, 5) recreate the issue, 6) fix and then go back to 1 if there is another error
